img.caption: Fig 3: Calibration quality (ECE, 15-bin, lower is better) and intra-domain false-reject rate. CICC and MULACONF are poorly calibrated (ECE 0.16-0.54) and reject 59-100% of in-domain queries to maintain coverage. QP-10shot over-generates and never rejects (false-reject 0.00) but its confidence is miscalibrated (ECE 0.15-0.47). Ours attains the lowest ECE on CLINC150 (0.005) and MixSNIPS (0.045) while keeping false refusal within 4.6-20.8%.
